title: 2026 Topps Series 1 Rookie Card Lot 10 Schlittler Cole Young Gilbert Matthews RC
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Lots
descriptionText:
Lot of 10 rookie cards from 2026 Topps Series 1 featuring the Topps 75 design.

Included in this lot:

* Cam Schlittler – New York Yankees
* Chad Stevens – Los Angeles Angels
* Brice Matthews – Houston Astros
* Anthony Seigler – Milwaukee Brewers
* Joe Rock – Tampa Bay Rays
* Luis Morales – Athletics
* Nolan McLean – New York Mets
* Drew Gilbert – San Francisco Giants
* Tristin English – Arizona Diamondbacks
* Cole Young – Seattle Mariners

All cards shown in the photos are included. Cards are ungraded and appear to be in very nice condition with clean surfaces, corners and edges. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition.

Great rookie lot featuring players from multiple MLB teams, including Yankees rookie Cam Schlittler and Mariners rookie Cole Young.

Cards will be packaged securely for shipping.
